# MindGains AI

> MindGains is where Indian government-exam aspirants (UPSC, TNPSC, SSC) study together live. The Live Theatre is a 3D study hall where students watch classes together, chat and answer live quizzes; NationLap is a live national quiz race with a nightly rank. Pro (from ₹99, one-time) adds unlimited theatre time and Batch rooms: private theatres for friends, classmates or a tuition batch. The MindGains Android app adds textbook-grounded AI answers and a 160,000+ question bank.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://mindgains.ai/): overview of MindGains
- [MindGains Pro](https://mindgains.ai/pro/): plans from ₹99/month; unlimited Live Theatre, Batch rooms for friends and classmates; Teacher plans from ₹299/month
- [NationLap](https://mindgains.ai/play/): live national quiz race
- [Live Theatre](https://mindgains.ai/play/theatre/): 3D study hall with live classes, chat and quizzes (30 minutes free daily)
